messages:
Asha: Heads-up — ACME Health reported their payment didn't go through and flagged they need Net 60 approval before we retry. Customer says card declined twice (Stripe code `card_declined`) and they require a PO on the invoice for internal approval. Blocking their deployment scheduled for tomorrow. /cc @Eloise

Ben: Looking at payment logs: charge attempts returned `card_declined` with decline_code `insufficient_funds`. Gateway: stripe-prod. No VAT flag on decline. We can offer a temporary credit line up to $50k while finance reviews net terms, but Net 60 permanent change needs exec sign-off and AR risk assessment. What's the invoice total?

Asha: Invoice total USD 42,300. Customer is EU (DE) — they also asked for VAT breakdown for AP. They uploaded PO-ACME-9876 but the PO number is not printed on the PDF they were charged against.

Marie: @Ben @Eloise I'll check contract history. ACME had one prior purchase order last year. Sales: do we have any signed net terms beyond standard T&Cs (Net 30)?

Eloise: They only have our standard T&Cs (Net 30). Customer procurement is insisting on Net 60 plus PO stamping on invoice. I can escalate on the sales side but finance needs to confirm willingness to take payment risk. Asha — can you request a signed PO (or at minimum an email from procurement approving PO number)?

PaymentsBot: [system] payment_attempts: 2, last_response: 402 Payment Required (card_declined), stripe_code: card_declined, gateway: stripe-prod

Asha: Sent a message to the customer requesting signed PO PDF and VAT ID. Provided our wire instructions as fallback. Asked whether they can do bank transfer to clear the hold.

Ben: For a short-term unblock we can approve provisional credit for 30 days if Sales provides a signed PO and Eloise confirms customer commitment. For a permanent Net 60 switch we need AR to run a credit & collections assessment and sign-off from Finance leadership. I can prepare a provisional reissued invoice template that includes PO number and VAT breakdown once we have docs.

Marie: To reissue we need: original invoice number, PO number, VAT ID, billing address, and the buyer signature or official procurement email confirmation. Who will collect?

Asha: I'll collect. Customer just uploaded a PO PDF (link: https://files.acme/proc/PO-ACME-9876.pdf) — it's not signed but includes PO number and buyer contact. They asked whether an unsigned PO will pass their internal controls. They also requested we put the invoice on hold until Net 60 is approved.

Ben: Unsigned PO isn't sufficient for our risk policy. We need a signed PO or an explicit procurement approval email from a verified buyer address. I'm willing to provisionally accept an emailed confirmation + sales note as interim, but only with Sales & AR confirmation. I'll block a provisional credit line in the ledger pending docs.

Eloise: I'll ping my procurement contact (Carla) and ask for a scanned signed PO and for her to sign the net terms addendum. Pushing for this today.

Asha: Customer ETA: will return signed PO + VAT ID in 3–4 hours. Action items: Asha collect docs + upload, Eloise chase signed addendum, Ben prepare provisional credit and reissued invoice template.

Ben: I'll create a provisional AR entry and flag for Net 60 review. If we get signed docs before EOD we can clear the hold and either reattempt the card (with customer approval) or accept bank transfer.

Asha: Reissue preview I'm going to use once docs arrive:
```invoice
Invoice: INV-2026-431
Amount: USD 42,300
PO: PO-ACME-9876
VAT ID: <TBD>
Billing address: ACME Health GmbH, Berlin
```

Marie: Marking thread as blocked -> awaiting signed PO + VAT ID + procurement confirmation. Please post final state here.

Asha: Will update. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
